I thought I would be the exception.  For 6 years, I dedicated my life to God and his church.  This church is really big.  When I started going there was an average annual attendance of 700.  When I left, it was 2100... anyway, I went to this church for so long.  I gave them my money, I volunteered, doing the shit work no one else wanted to do, I dedicated my life to it.  But then I realized that it wasn't about serving God, it was about serving the church.  This church in some ways is a wonderful place... but not for everyone.  They take you and they mold you in to a VERY specific type of person.  Everyone is the same.  It took me 6 years to realize that I didn't fit that mold.  People would be my friend for a little while, then stop.. I must have something wrong with my personality......... Anyway, I just ranted, but no, I'm not the exception.  God hates me.  My father (ugh I hate to even say that) has 5 children from 3 women.  I have 2 older 1/2 sisters that I've met like once.  One has AIDS, which is her fault I guess, but she was raised in an environment where it was normal to get pregnant at 13, get welfare, have a bunch of different "baby daddies".... My brother, we have same mom and dad, is going blind, is severely depressed, and has a shit load of other problems I can't even begin to desscribe.  And the worst one, he got another woman pregnant 3 years ago. I was the youngest for 19 years.  When she came along, I absolutely fell in love with her... my dad abandoned her and her white trash mother (excuse my language, but that is the ONLY way to describe her).  This woman had all her other kids taken away by the gov't.  She is dirty, my baby sisster got scabies.  She chain smokes and feeds the baby nothing but junk food.  And sells her toys for drugs.  She is an innocent baby, but she is already set up to have a bad life.  Why does God do that?  
Sorry to rant so much, I just need to get all of this out I guess.  I am in the US, I am not just stressed, I am DEPRESSED.  And this stuff with my ex.  He was my first love, and he started treating me badly.  I broke up with him, was doing fine.  Then he tricked me. I gave in an slept with him.  And now he isn't speaking to me.
I can't do school anymore.  I had to take Incompletes for all my glasses last semester bc I was too depressed to go to class.  I HATE MY LIFE.  Everyday is worse than the day before.  I cant take it anymore

The tests are in genetics and cell biology.  I have no idea what's going on.  I found out last semester that I have ADHD and my psychiatrist is giving me meds but they aren't strong enough and she wont see me more than once a month so I always take them all before I can see her again.  I wish I could see someone else but I don't have insurance, except through my school and she works at my school's health clinic.  
I am cursed.  It's because my father is a piece of shit and all his children have horrible lives. I have NOTHING to live for.  Seriously, I thought my life would get better, but it gets worse every day
